High-resolution UI/UX mockup of a Registration/Sign-up page for "MLOps Automation Platform". Full screen, 2-column layout on desktop.

LEFT COLUMN (50%): Background gradient from #09090b to #18181b. Top-left corner shows "MLOps Platform" logo in white. Centered registration form with:
- Title: "Crea tu cuenta" in white bold, large font
- Subtitle: "Empieza a automatizar tus pipelines de ML" in gray #a1a1aa
- "Nombre completo" input field with dark background #18181b, border #27272a, white text, gray placeholder
- Email input field same style

- "Confirmar contraseña" input field same style
- Checkbox "Acepto los términos y condiciones" with link
- Full-width "Crear Cuenta" button with background #fafafa, text #09090b, rounded-xl
- Divider line with text "o regístrate con" in gray
- "Continuar con GitHub" button with GitHub icon, border #27272a, transparent background
- Bottom text: "¿Ya tienes cuenta? Inicia sesión" with link in white

RIGHT COLUMN (50%): Darker background #09090b with subtle geometric line patterns and abstract ML pipeline visualization, monochromatic. Decorative abstract illustration related to machine learning and data pipelines.

Style: Dark theme, monochromatic palette using only #09090b, #18181b, #27272a, #a1a1aa, #fafafa. Inter typography. Subtle glassmorphism on the form card. Premium, corporate, clean look. 4K resolution mockup.
